capabilities: Classify Inbox notes into PARA destination folders using folder criteria and a hosted Jev API
Define folder eligibility and include/exclude criteria in each folder's INDEX.md
Preview suggested destinations with confidence and probability, then move selected or all ready notes
Automatically move notes after a settle time when confidence and probability thresholds are met
Undo the last move run and restore files to their original locations
extras: Classification sends note titles, content, and folder criteria to the Jev/TypeSafe API endpoint and may incur API charges; development documents (IMPLEMENTATION_PROMPT.md, TEST_SCENARIOS.md) are currently in Korean.
problem: Obsidian offers no automatic way to file new notes from an Inbox into a PARA folder structure; users must sort each note by hand.

relations.evidence: Classification requires a Jev/TypeSafe account and an API token with access to its hosted API.

summary: AI-assisted organizer that classifies notes in an Inbox folder into PARA folders using per-folder criteria and a hosted Jev API.
